description: Single-panel thermodynamic plot (composite of six curves, no micrograph or photo) showing the relationship among logK_TiN, logQ_TiN and the solidification fraction z_s. The y-axis is labelled "logK_TiN & logQ_TiN" with ticks at -2.5, -3.0, -3.5, -4.0 and -4.5; the x-axis is labelled "z_s" with ticks at 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95 and 1.00. Three solid curves (logK) and three dashed curves (logQ) are drawn in black, blue and red. A legend box in the lower right lists, by colour and line style: logK (1#), logQ (1#), logK (2#), logQ (2#), logK (3#), logQ (3#). The solid logK curves fall with increasing z_s — the red (3#) curve descends steeply from about -2.7 toward -3.8, while the black (1#) curve is nearly flat near -3.5 — whereas the dashed logQ curves rise with z_s, the black and red dashed curves climbing from near -4.0 to about -2.6. Each logK/logQ pair intersects at one point, marked with a filled circle and an arrow: black at 0.89 (1#), blue at 0.93 (2#) and red at 0.94 (3#). These intersections identify the solidification fraction at which TiN precipitation begins; shifting Al content from 1# to 3# progressively delays TiN precipitation to higher z_s.

subfigures.description: One Cartesian plot of logK_TiN and logQ_TiN versus z_s (0.80-1.00). Six curves: solid black/blue/red labelled logK (1#)/(2#)/(3#) and dashed black/blue/red labelled logQ (1#)/(2#)/(3#). Three arrow-annotated filled circles mark the intersections: 0.89 (1#), 0.93 (2#), 0.94 (3#). Legend box lower right.

observations.observation: The y-axis is labelled "logK_TiN & logQ_TiN" with gridline ticks at -2.5, -3.0, -3.5, -4.0 and -4.5; the x-axis is labelled "z_s" with ticks at 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95 and 1.00.
Six curves are plotted, distinguished by colour and line style: solid lines for logK and dashed lines for logQ, in black (1#), blue (2#) and red (3#).
The legend box in the lower right reads logK (1#), logQ (1#), logK (2#), logQ (2#), logK (3#), logQ (3#), matching the black/blue/red solid and dashed curves.
The solid logK curves decrease with increasing z_s, most strongly for the red 3# curve, whereas the dashed logQ curves increase with increasing z_s.
Three filled circular markers with arrows label the logK/logQ intersection points as 0.89 (1#) in black, 0.93 (2#) in blue and 0.94 (3#) in red.
The black dashed logQ (1#) curve is the steepest riser, crossing the nearly flat black logK (1#) curve at z_s = 0.89, the lowest z_s of the three intersections.
The intersection z_s value increases monotonically in the order 1# (0.89) < 2# (0.93) < 3# (0.94).
The caption states the figure shows the relationship among logK_TiN, logQ_TiN and z_s.
The citing text states the solidification fractions of TiN inclusion precipitation in the 1# to 3# samples are 0.89, 0.93 and 0.94, respectively.

The citing text states that increasing Al content delays TiN inclusion precipitation: the fraction changes from 0.89 to 0.93 when Al rises from 1% to 3%, and from 0.93 to 0.94 when Al rises from 3% to 5%.
The figure itself does not print the Al contents; that the 1#, 2# and 3# samples correspond to 1%, 3% and 5% Al comes only from the citing text.
